source.decision_recall.calculation: Evaluator-pinned required source decisions represented in the artifact / all evaluator-pinned required source decisions

source.required_scenario_recall.calculation: Evaluator-pinned required scenarios represented with observable verification / all evaluator-pinned required scenarios

source.traceability.calculation: Decision-bearing artifact claims linked to a primary-source ID / all decision-bearing artifact claims
source.traceability.na_policy: not applicable when the artifact has no decision-bearing claim and source recall is scored separately

ticket.source_coverage.calculation: Evaluator-pinned required source IDs with exactly one ticket owner / all evaluator-pinned required source IDs
ticket.source_coverage.na_policy: not applicable when no ticket graph exists

ticket.cold_reader_questions.calculation: Product or design questions a blind implementation reader must answer before starting
ticket.cold_reader_questions.na_policy: not applicable when independent cold-reader sampling is unavailable

ticket.blocking_cycle_count.calculation: Cycles reported by the deterministic ticket validator
ticket.blocking_cycle_count.na_policy: not applicable when no ticket graph exists

review.seeded_finding_recall_by_severity.calculation: Evaluator-seeded findings reported at expected severity / all evaluator-seeded findings
review.seeded_finding_recall_by_severity.na_policy: not applicable when no finding inventory is seeded

review.false_positive_rate.calculation: Reported findings without reproducible impact or accurate evidence / all reported findings
review.false_positive_rate.na_policy: zero when no findings are reported and seeded-finding recall is scored separately

review.citation_accuracy.calculation: Findings whose cited location supports the claim / all findings with a citation
review.citation_accuracy.na_policy: not applicable when no finding is reported

review.severity_calibration.calculation: Valid findings assigned evaluator-pinned severity / all valid findings
review.severity_calibration.na_policy: not applicable when no valid finding exists

code.acceptance_pass_rate.calculation: Evaluator-owned acceptance checks passed / all evaluator-owned acceptance checks
code.acceptance_pass_rate.na_policy: never for an implementation or full-chain case

code.comprehension_accuracy.calculation: Correct answers to pinned business-rule and failure-policy questions / all pinned questions
code.comprehension_accuracy.na_policy: not applicable when no blind evaluator is available

code.rule_location_ms.calculation: Milliseconds until a blind evaluator identifies the authoritative rule location
code.rule_location_ms.na_policy: censored at the predeclared task timeout when no correct location is found

code.change_amplification.calculation: Production modules and independently owned rule locations changed for the pinned follow-up; timeout or failure receives the predeclared worst censored value
code.change_amplification.beneficial_direction: lower conditional on follow-up acceptance and comprehension non-inferiority
code.change_amplification.na_policy: never when a follow-up is declared

code.followup_acceptance.calculation: Pinned follow-up behavior is complete and evaluator-owned acceptance checks pass
code.followup_acceptance.na_policy: never when a follow-up is declared

code.unauthorized_fallback_count.calculation: Detected substitute paths without source-backed trigger, result, and observability
code.unauthorized_fallback_count.na_policy: zero is meaningful when no fallback is required

code.required_fallback_coverage.calculation: Source-required fallback branches with correct behavior and observability / all source-required fallback branches
code.required_fallback_coverage.na_policy: not applicable when no fallback is required

evaluation.component_outcome_noninferior.calculation: All component-ablation primary outcome intervals remain within predeclared non-inferiority margins

evaluation.component_variance_noninferio.calculation: Component-ablation variance interval remains within the predeclared non-inferiority margin

cost.context_tokens.calculation: Input tokens attributable to the selected skill arm
cost.context_tokens.na_policy: not applicable when the harness cannot attribute tokens by arm

cost.runtime_ms.calculation: Wall-clock milliseconds from task start to terminal result
